nodes.rationale: Reconciled specification for Codex review; not an authorization to implement, deploy, fund or sign. Consolidates accepted D1-D9 contracts, host-model and probe evidence, and labels each claim ACCEPTED/MODELED/PROBED/DRAFT/PROPOSED/LAUNCH.

nodes.label: Native Solana decision register (2026-10-13 planning pass)
nodes.rationale: DR-01..DR-28 recommendations for Codex review and Rob decision, each classified ROUTINE/ROB/MEASURE/LAUNCH/DEFERRED; does not reopen D1-D9.

nodes.label: state.rs (draft production tranche)
nodes.rationale: Uncommitted draft account definitions at solana/programs/musical_chairs/src/state.rs. Unreviewed, untested, in places NotImplemented; correctness not assumed. Spec delta (inventory 5.1): add ConfigVersion, CloseRecord, ParticipantPage, CandidatePage, RngAuthority; move closing/closed_at/deadline from Pool to CloseRecord; add config_version to Position; widen Pool.funded_claims to u128.

nodes.label: 1. Scope and authority boundary
nodes.rationale: Fresh native SOL game, new deposits only; legacy ICP Chain Fusion rail untouched; PP/Shenanigans/profiles/chat/referrals and the React GUI stay on ICP.

nodes.label: 2. Reconciliation decisions (R1-R19)
nodes.rationale: Each row names a disagreement between documents or between documents and source, and the reading adopted.

nodes.label: 3. Economic contract
nodes.rationale: All values lamports; floor division; checked arithmetic; P is gross principal. ACCEPTED, MODELED in the host reference model (72 tests).

nodes.label: 4. Round lifecycle
nodes.rationale: ACCEPTED and MODELED lifecycle from Active through Closing to Active(round_id+1).

nodes.label: 5. Governance and operations
nodes.rationale: D8/D6 governance: autonomous Squads G, immediate Squads P pause, recipients, initialization check, prospective config changes, disclosure.

nodes.label: 6. Account contract
nodes.rationale: Draft names adopted per DR-01; additions PROPOSED. Sizes to be measured; seeds are a public contract; integers little-endian.

nodes.label: 7. Instruction contract
nodes.rationale: Per-instruction signers, writable accounts, CPIs, preconditions, postconditions and replay behavior. Every instruction fails atomically on any check.

nodes.label: 7.5 Events (emit_cpi)

nodes.rationale: PROBED: lazy error construction (eager ok_or exhausted 32 KiB bump heap at 16 reps); reject duplicate writable keys in Prune/Allocate; kernel packet sizes 8 rows 518 B, 16 rows 782 B, 32 rows 1,310 B on a stripped kernel.

nodes.label: 8. Resource reservation, refunds and cleanup
nodes.rationale: ACCEPTED; DRAFT partially; PROPOSED DR-12 to DR-14.

nodes.rationale: ACCEPTED; PROPOSED DR-24/DR-25: new native_sol_bridge canister with two-RPC finalized verification and exactly-once PP legs.

nodes.rationale: ACCEPTED D9; DR-21: external fee-only primary plus ICP watchdog.

nodes.label: 11. Frontend native adapter
nodes.rationale: ACCEPTED scope; PROPOSED DR-22/DR-23: unchanged stack, typed adapter, legacy/v0 transactions.

nodes.label: 12. Testing and proof obligations summary
nodes.rationale: Failing-first tests per area with runtime proof class and today status (economics MODELED 72; allocation host MODELED, SBF DRAFT; resource/refund, frontend, bridge, devnet not started).

nodes.label: Authority boundary table (Solana vs browser vs ICP)
nodes.rationale: Solana program (program-owned PDAs) holds pot, seed, management, pending toll, funded claims, unallocated excess and decides admission, payout eligibility, insolvency, Backer allocation, promotion winner and lifecycle. Browser builds/simulates/signs/submits. ICP does PP minting, feeds, history and social identity via a disclosed trust boundary; may submit keeper work from a fee-only key. ICP never holds a pool spending key or decides solvency/winners; a SIWS delegation is social identity, not financial authority. Solana note: code (Program/ProgramData under upgrade authority) and state (PDAs) are separate; every touched account must be listed in the transaction.

nodes.label: 3.8 Parity matrix (reconciled)
nodes.rationale: Feature-by-feature first-release contract vs legacy: preserve plans, Front-End Load, Carried Interest/Jackpot Fee, Backer toll, promotion; accepted differences: integer precision, network fees, public A on, atomic quota, availability processing, operating costs, unallocated excess, PP rail separate.

nodes.label: 4.1 Permission matrix during processing
nodes.rationale: Operation vs {nonclosing ticket active, Closing, Admission paused}: open_position allowed with nonclosing ticket only; fund_series_a and registry mutation always rejected during processing; another payout waits for commit; claim_backer of finalized funds always allowed; advance_ticket/provisioning/cleanup allowed for any payer; withdraw_management always allowed; config activation only when Active, no ticket.

nodes.label: Fresh native SOL game, no import of legacy positions
nodes.rationale: D1-D2: no import of legacy positions, Backer promises, balances or reserves.

nodes.label: Legacy ponzi_math_sol rail untouched
nodes.rationale: Legacy ICP Chain Fusion positions (ponzi_math_sol, mainnet spc6q-xyaaa-aaaac-qg2ma-cai) keep withdrawal, settlement, Backer-claim and desk paths, separately labeled; nothing here pauses, drains, upgrades or shuts them down.

nodes.label: PP, Shenanigans, desk, profiles, chat, referrals and GUI stay on ICP
nodes.rationale: Ponzi Points, Shenanigans, Founder PP desk, profiles, chat, referrals and the React/Vite GUI on ICP certified asset hosting remain.

nodes.label: Pool account
nodes.rationale: Seeds ["pool"]; sponsor-paid; permanent. Holds round_id, phase, active_config_version, pot/seed/management/pending_toll (u64), global_funded_claims u128, unallocated_excess, protected_rent, registry/snapshot/participant counters, ticket_active, next_close_id, current_close_id, governance/guardian vaults, recipients, stats. Draft stores close time/deadline here; spec moves them to CloseRecord (R11) and widens funded_claims to u128 (R17).

nodes.label: Admission account
nodes.rationale: Seeds ["admission"]; sponsor-paid; permanent. Fields paused bool, changed_at i64. Only account (besides P Vault signer) touched by set_admission_pause.

nodes.label: GameVault account
nodes.rationale: Seeds ["game-vault"]; zero-data program-owned lamport holder; lamports moved by direct debit/credit. Physical custody of pot, seed, management, pending toll, funded claims and unallocated excess. Solana note: closest ICP analogue is the canister balance, but here it is a separate program-owned account.

nodes.label: Ops account
nodes.rationale: Seeds ["ops"]; program-owned ledger for sponsor operations cash: free_balance, locked_total, protected_rent, total_contributed/withdrawn/provider_consumed/rent_funded.

nodes.label: OpsCash account
nodes.rationale: Seeds ["ops-cash"]; system-owned zero-data PDA; pays shared-account rent via invoke_signed (DR-06). Solana note: a PDA can pay rent only if the program signs for it in a CPI.

nodes.label: User account
nodes.rationale: Seeds ["user", owner]; owner-paid; permanent. owner, has_ever_a, has_ever_b, quota_timestamps [i64;3], created_at. has_ever_b written at promotion.

nodes.label: UserRound account
nodes.rationale: Seeds ["user-round", round u64, owner]; owner-paid; permanent history. round_id, owner, gross_deposits u128, net_payouts u128, participant_slot u64. Source of loss for candidate selection and promotion.

nodes.label: Position account
nodes.rationale: Seeds ["position", owner, nonce u64]; owner-paid, reclaimable after Closed. owner, nonce, round_id, config_version (added by spec), plan, gross u64, opened_at, expires_at, last_accrued_at, remainder u32, gross_paid/net_paid u128, status, closed_at. Pins the terms it was created under.

nodes.label: Backer account
nodes.rationale: Seeds ["backer", series u8, owner]; owner-paid (A); ops plus optional owner component (B). amount, entitlement, lifetime_credited u128, funded_claimable u64, pending_ticket_id, pending_credit u64, first_funding_seq, registry_slot Option, rent_funded_by_ops/owner.

nodes.label: RegistryPage account
nodes.rationale: Seeds ["registry", page u64]; ops-funded (+ owner component); permanent/reusable. 8 rows of {owner, series}; global across rounds by accepted design.

nodes.label: SnapshotPage account
nodes.rationale: Seeds ["snapshot", page u64]; ops-funded (+ owner); reusable. 8 rows {owner, series, original_slot, remainder, weight, credited, done} tagged with ticket_id so a stale page is never read as current.

nodes.label: Ticket account
nodes.rationale: Seeds ["ticket"]; sponsor-paid; permanent singleton reused per toll (DR-07). ticket_id, phase, closing, close_id, toll, seed0, senior/a/b slices, captured_registry_version/len, cursors (discover/allocate/prune), counts, remainders, oldest_a, senior_credit, sealed_a_denominator U256, credited_total, seed_destination, work units, pinned split bps.

nodes.label: RngAuthority account
nodes.rationale: Seeds ["rng-authority"]; sponsor-paid; permanent. ORAO registered-client "State" signer PDA; client Pubkey. PROPOSED addition to state.rs.

nodes.label: ConfigVersion account
nodes.rationale: Seeds ["config", version u32]; sponsor-paid (G stages); permanent. effective_round_id, plan table, front_end_load_bps=400, min_game, min_a, quota 3/3600, seed 5000 / senior 3500 / a 4500 / b 2000 bps, A entitlement 12400, B 11600, open_cutoff 10, deadline_seconds 600, close_reserve_lamports (LAUNCH), provider tuple, public_series_a_enabled, page_capacity 8. PROPOSED addition (DR-04).

nodes.label: ParticipantPage account
nodes.rationale: Seeds ["participants", round u64, page u64]; ops (+ owner) funded; closable after round finalized. Rows are 32-byte owner pubkeys (DR-03). PROPOSED addition.

nodes.label: CloseRecord account
nodes.rationale: Seeds ["close", close_id u64]; ops (+ owner) funded; permanent, never closable (DR-13). Pins close_started_at, promotion_deadline, config_version, ticket link, cash_committed, participant_count, candidate cursor/digests/set tag, draw_state, protocol_seed, request_account, randomness [u8;64], promotion outcome, finalized, locked_sponsor/locked_owner, owner_refund_destination, provider_consumed, reserve_settled. PROPOSED addition (DR-02) so old callbacks cannot attach to later rounds.

nodes.label: CandidatePage account
nodes.rationale: Seeds ["candidates", close_id u64, set_tag u8, page u64]; ops (+ owner) funded; closable after promotion terminal. Rows are 32-byte owner pubkeys (DR-03). PROPOSED addition.

nodes.label: ORAO NetworkState account (provider-owned)
nodes.rationale: Provider-owned; part of pinned provider tuple in ConfigVersion. ORAO program ID VRFCBePmGTpZ234BhbzNNzmyg39Rgdd6VgdfhHwKypU on devnet and mainnet (public README 2026-10-13).

nodes.label: ORAO Treasury account (provider-owned)
nodes.rationale: Provider-owned; receives request fee; part of pinned provider tuple.

nodes.label: ORAO registered Client account (owned by RngAuthority)
nodes.rationale: One registered client owned by the program rng-authority PDA (DR-17); funded from locked reserve for requests.

nodes.label: ORAO RequestAccount (provider-owned)
nodes.rationale: Pending 759 B to fulfilled 147 B, PROBED. SDK exposes no close instruction so a fulfilled request is assumed retained on chain until devnet proves otherwise.

nodes.label: G Vault (Squads vault PDA, autonomous 2-of-3)
nodes.rationale: Autonomous Squads v4 2-of-3, time_lock 172,800 s, config_authority Pubkey::default(), no spending limits. Vault PDA is the program upgrade authority and sole signer for stage_config_version, recipient and guardian rotation. Solana note: Squads is a program; its Vault is a PDA that signs via CPI when a Squads transaction executes.

nodes.label: P Vault (Squads vault PDA, immediate 2-of-3)
nodes.rationale: Separate immediate 2-of-3 Squads (time_lock 0); its Vault alone may set_admission_pause.

nodes.label: ProgramData account (loader upgrade authority)
nodes.rationale: BPF upgradeable-loader account whose upgrade_authority must equal the G Vault at initialize. Solana note: analogue of a canister controller list, but the check is against the loader account.

nodes.label: Squads Multisig account (profile-check target)
nodes.rationale: Profile check reads discriminator sha256("account:Multisig")[0..8], plain 32-byte config_authority == Pubkey::default(), threshold 2, exactly three voting members, time_lock 172_800 for G and 0 for P, vault index 0 PDA match. Squads program pinned to SQDS4ep65T869zMMBKyuUq6aD6EgTu8psMjkvj52pCf on mainnet and devnet.

nodes.label: Pot
nodes.rationale: Physical SOL in GameVault paying earnings; decremented by gross_paid; funded by pot_credit (96% of gross) and Series A full gross; inherits seed at finalize.

nodes.label: Seed
nodes.rationale: Next-round seed accumulated from toll split; carried in full exactly once at finalize_round; starts at zero.

nodes.label: Management balance
nodes.rationale: Accrued Front-End Load (4% of gross) withdrawable by the management recipient via withdraw_management.

nodes.label: Pending toll
nodes.rationale: Toll collected but not yet committed to Backer credits/seed; pending credits and pending seed are subdivisions of pending_toll until Commit.

nodes.label: Global funded claims
nodes.rationale: checked u128 liability to Backers whose credits are finalized; asserted <= vault spendable lamports (DR-05/R17); lowered by claim_backer by the same amount as physical lamports.

nodes.label: Unallocated excess
nodes.rationale: Anonymous transfers into GameVault raise unallocated_excess and nothing else; no instruction spends, credits, refunds or sweeps it in first release (DR-15).

nodes.label: Admission and entry formula (Front-End Load)
nodes.rationale: front_end_load = floor(P*400/10_000) to management; pot_credit = P - load; Position.gross = P (accrual base GROSS); min_game 0.01 SOL, min_A 0.05 SOL. Series A adds full gross with no load. ACCEPTED; MODELED.

nodes.label: Atomic rolling quota (3 per 3,600 s)
nodes.rationale: Three successful open_position/fund_series_a per owner per rolling 3,600 s; a timestamp exactly 3,600 s old has expired; failed calls and claims do not count. R5 replaces legacy intent-time check. ACCEPTED D5; MODELED.

nodes.label: Series A and Series B entitlement formulas
nodes.rationale: A: pot += gross, entitlement += floor(P*124/100). B: entitlement += floor(loss*116/100), adds no cash. Prospective B width check in U256 before accepting a game deposit so promotion cannot fail on width.

nodes.label: Simple plan accrual (11%/day, 21-day cap)
nodes.rationale: elapsed = min(now-last_accrued_at, max(0, expires_at-last_accrued_at)); numerator = P*11*elapsed + remainder; owed = floor(numerator/8_640_000); remainder carried. Backwards clock rejected; maturity terminates the position; close_simple_position requires maturity.

nodes.label: Carried Interest tiers (1,200/750/300 bps)
nodes.rationale: Applied to gross actually paid: <7 days 1,200 bps; >=7 and <14 days 750; >=14 days 300.

nodes.label: Compounding plans (Compound15/Compound30)
nodes.rationale: Compound15: 12%/day 15 days ROI15_Q18=4_473_565_759_257_037_859, Jackpot Fee 900 bps. Compound30: 9%/day 30 days ROI30_Q18=12_267_678_469_131_246_220, Jackpot Fee 1,300 bps. owed=floor(P*ROI_Q18/10^18); settlement only at/after maturity; principal not returned.

nodes.label: Payout, insolvency and toll formula
nodes.rationale: gross_paid=min(owed,pot); closing = owed > pot (strict, equality solvent); toll=floor(gross_paid*bps/10_000); net=gross_paid-toll must satisfy net>=minimum_receive else atomic failure; pot -= gross_paid; pending_toll += toll; UserRound.net_payouts += net. Zero toll creates no allocation ticket.

nodes.label: Toll split rule (half seed; 35/45/20 senior/A/B with folding)
nodes.rationale: seed0=floor(T/2); H=T-seed0; senior=floor(H*35/100), a_pool=floor(H*45/100), b_pool=floor(H*20/100); remainder to seed. Membership captured before senior credit: no open B folds b_pool into a_pool; no open A folds a_pool into b_pool and senior to seed; no open Backer sends T to seed. Senior credited first to oldest open A (first_funding_seq), capped; sealed A denominator = sum of captured remainders - senior_credit; A pro-rata in U256, B equal floor share, all overshoot/residue to seed; open means remaining > 10 lamports; if senior closes the only A its a_pool goes to seed (not re-folded to B).

nodes.label: Width contract (u64 / u128 / U256)
nodes.rationale: Transferred SOL, pot, seed, management, pending toll, local credits: checked u64. Owed earnings, cumulative counters, Backer amount/entitlement/lifetime credited, UserRound gross/net, global funded claims: checked u128. Sealed A denominator and slice*headroom products: fixed U256 (ethnum, 32-byte LE). Owed may exceed u64: compare to pot before narrowing. A narrower draft width is a defect (DR-05).

nodes.label: No dynamic deposit cap in native
nodes.rationale: Legacy getMaxDepositLimit (20% of pot or 5 SOL) is a query only and never enforced; native has no dynamic cap, cooldown or population cap (D5).

nodes.label: No credit/refund/sweep/winner/reset ABI
nodes.rationale: Native has no manual-credit ABI; unsolicited SOL becomes unallocated excess; accepted native restriction.

nodes.label: Game vault conservation identity
nodes.rationale: game_vault.lamports - protected_rent == pot + seed + management + pending_toll + global_funded_claims + unallocated_excess. ACCEPTED; MODELED for the game vault; SBF conservation across randomized sequences still DRAFT.

nodes.label: Operations cash conservation identity
nodes.rationale: ops_cash.lamports - protected_rent == ops.free_balance + sum(CloseRecord.locked_sponsor unsettled) (+ sum locked_owner, tracked separately).

nodes.label: Entitlements are promises, not cash
nodes.rationale: Entitlements do not appear in conservation identities; only funded claims are liabilities against physical lamports.

nodes.label: Claim lowers funded claims and lamports equally
nodes.rationale: A claim lowers global_funded_claims and physical lamports by the same amount, preserving conservation.

nodes.label: Prospective Series B width check
nodes.rationale: Before any game deposit: existing_B_entitlement + floor(max(gross_deposits_after - net_payouts,0)*116/100) must fit u128 (U256 check).

nodes.label: Ticket commit balance: credited + seed destination = toll
nodes.rationale: At Commit: credited_total + seed_destination == toll; then pending_toll -= toll, seed += seed_destination, global_funded_claims += credited_total.

nodes.label: No duplicate account key among writable rows
nodes.rationale: advance_ticket rejects duplicate keys among writable rows (alias guard): two decoded copies of one account would serialize stale state over each other. PROBED lesson.

nodes.label: Lazy error construction in loops
nodes.rationale: Use ok_or_else; eager ok_or(error!()) exhausted the 32 KiB bump heap at 16 repetitions in the probe.

nodes.label: Every instruction fails atomically
nodes.rationale: Solana reverts all account writes in a failed transaction; rollback lists only state that must not be partially observable across instructions.

nodes.label: No hidden fee deduction from net
nodes.rationale: Network fees paid by fee payer, account rent by recorded rent payer; neither deducted from net. Every positive funded lamport claimable; no silent tiny-payout success (R4, D5).

nodes.label: No first-caller enrollment at initialize
nodes.rationale: initialize requires ProgramData.upgrade_authority == G Vault and the G Vault signature; pot and seed start at zero.

nodes.label: Cleanup never blocks commit, finalize or reopen
nodes.rationale: Account cleanup is never a precondition for cash commit, finalization or reopening.

nodes.label: Pinned terms for in-flight objects
nodes.rationale: Position, Ticket and CloseRecord pin the ConfigVersion terms they were created under; future schedule cannot rewrite pinned liabilities (DR-04).

nodes.label: ICP holds no pool spending key
nodes.rationale: ICP never holds a pool spending key, never signs ordinary payouts, never decides solvency or winners; SIWS delegation is social identity only.

nodes.label: Round state: Active
nodes.rationale: Pool.phase Active; admission open (subject to pause); entered at initialize and after finalize_round with round_id+1. ACCEPTED; MODELED.

nodes.label: Closing: cash AllocatingClosingToll
nodes.rationale: Entered by owner payout with owed > pot; promotion_deadline = close_started_at + 600 pinned immutably; participant_count copied. ACCEPTED; MODELED.

nodes.label: Closing: cash Committed
nodes.rationale: Closing ticket Commit sets CloseRecord.cash_committed; zero toll skips directly to candidates. ACCEPTED; MODELED.

nodes.label: Closing: candidates Counting
nodes.rationale: build_candidates traverses participant slots with an exact cursor until cursor == participant_count. ACCEPTED; MODELED.

nodes.label: Closing: candidates Sealed, draw NotRequested
nodes.rationale: Digests/counts sealed, selected_set_tag chosen; selected_count == 0 goes directly to Skipped(NoCandidates). ACCEPTED; MODELED.

nodes.label: Closing: draw Requested
nodes.rationale: request_round_draw with Clock <= deadline; marker written atomically with CPI success. ACCEPTED; MODELED.

nodes.label: Closing: draw Captured
nodes.rationale: capture_round_draw with Clock <= deadline (inclusive); randomness 64 bytes copied; immutable and may be applied later. ACCEPTED; MODELED.

nodes.label: Promotion Applied
nodes.rationale: apply_promotion maps counters 0..63 to an ordinal and credits Series B entitlement to the selected loser. ACCEPTED; MODELED.

nodes.label: Promotion Skipped(EntropyExhausted)
nodes.rationale: All 64 counters failed the rejection-sampling limit. ACCEPTED; MODELED.

nodes.label: Promotion Skipped(Deadline)
nodes.rationale: expire_promotion with Clock > deadline and no timely capture; diagnostic stage recorded. ACCEPTED; MODELED.

nodes.label: Promotion Skipped(NoCandidates)
nodes.rationale: Sealed with selected_count == 0. ACCEPTED; MODELED.

nodes.label: Immutable 600 s promotion deadline rule
nodes.rationale: promotion_deadline = close_started_at + 600 Clock seconds pinned at the closing payout, never reset. Timely capture (Clock <= deadline, inclusive) is immutable; expiry requires Clock > deadline and no timely capture. No reroll, no second seed, no fallback winner, no admin unlock. Candidate-only work may be abandoned at expiry; cash allocation, pending credits, funded claims and seed may not.

nodes.label: Finalize carries full seed exactly once
nodes.rationale: finalize_round carries the full seed into the pot exactly once, resets round-local counters, reopens admission; duplicate finalization of the same close is a no-op returning the original result. Direct open_position against a Closing round fails; client may compose expire_promotion, finalize_round, open_position(expected_round_id = old+1).

nodes.label: Ordinal mapping from randomness
nodes.rationale: r_c = u64_le(SHA256("MC/EEC/INDEX/v1" || output_64 || round_id_le || c_le)[0..8]); limit = floor(2^64/N)*N; counters c=0..63; first r_c < limit is mandatory; ordinal r_c mod N; all 64 failing gives Skipped(EntropyExhausted).

nodes.label: Protocol seed derivation
nodes.rationale: SHA256("SchemeWorks/MC/EEC/v1" || cluster_domain_32 || program_id_32 || round_id_le || close_id_le || set_tag_u8 || selected_count_le || sealed_digest_32).

nodes.label: Allocation phase: Discover
nodes.rationale: Snapshot rows written, cursor advanced, initial counts/remainders accumulated, oldest A found.

nodes.label: Allocation phase: Senior
nodes.rationale: Constant-work: senior credit applied; overshoot goes to seed_destination.

nodes.label: Allocation phase: SealWeights
nodes.rationale: Constant-work: sealed A denominator fixed once (post-senior).

nodes.label: Allocation phase: Allocate
nodes.rationale: Rows credited (pending_credit, lifetime_credited) with caps enforced.

nodes.label: Allocation phase: Prune
nodes.rationale: Newly capped rows swap-deleted in descending original-slot order; moved row registry_slot updated; registry_version bumps once at commit.

nodes.label: Allocation phase: Commit
nodes.rationale: Constant-work: credited_total + seed_destination == toll; pending_toll -= toll; seed += seed_destination; global_funded_claims += credited_total; ticket_active=false; closing ticket sets CloseRecord.cash_committed.

nodes.label: initialize(genesis)
nodes.rationale: S: G Vault via Squads CPI, S/P sponsor. Requires Program/ProgramData passed, ProgramData.upgrade_authority == G Vault, Pool absent, genesis config complete, pot=seed=0. Creates 7 singletons; active_config_version=1, round_id=1, next_close_id=1. Replay fails: Pool exists.

nodes.label: stage_config_version(terms)
nodes.rationale: S: G Vault; P: OpsCash. effective_round_id >= pool.round_id+1; terms within accepted bounds. Replay fails: version exists.

nodes.label: activate_config_version(v, expected_current)
nodes.rationale: Permissionless. v == expected_current+1 == pool.active+1; pool.round_id >= effective_round_id; phase Active; no ticket active. Replay fails: already active.

nodes.label: set_admission_pause(paused)
nodes.rationale: S: P Vault only; account list contains only Admission and the P Vault signer (DR-20). Idempotent.

nodes.label: rotate_recipient(kind, new)
nodes.rationale: S: G Vault; updates management or sponsor recipient effective immediately for future calls; idempotent.

nodes.label: rotate_guardian(new)
nodes.rationale: S: G Vault; updates guardian vault; idempotent.

nodes.label: withdraw_management(amount)
nodes.rationale: S: management recipient; amount <= pool.management; recipient == stored; management -= amount. Fails when insufficient.

nodes.label: fund_operations(amount)
nodes.rationale: S: any funder; amount > 0; free_balance += amount; total_contributed += amount; no Position/PP/quota/Backer effect. Repeatable.

nodes.label: withdraw_unreserved_operations(amount)
nodes.rationale: S: sponsor recipient; amount <= free_balance; ops_cash.lamports - amount >= protected_rent + locked_total.

nodes.label: provision_*_page(kind, index)
nodes.rationale: Permissionless; payer OpsCash or self-funder. index is next sequential; free_balance >= rent when ops-funded; pool.*_pages += 1; rent components recorded. Replay fails: exists.

nodes.label: provision_close_record(close_id)
nodes.rationale: Permissionless; close_id must be next sequential (pool.next_close_id); sponsor-paid via OpsCash. Must exist before any payout that could close is accepted (DR-02).

nodes.label: close_shared_account(kind)
nodes.rationale: Permissionless after kind-specific safe-closure predicate (DR-13); returns each rent component to its funder exactly once; fails if already closed.

nodes.label: open_position(plan, gross, client_nonce, expected_round_id, expected_config)
nodes.rationale: S: owner (lamport source, default fee payer); P: owner for User/UserRound/Position. !paused; Active (nonclosing ticket OK); round_id and config match expected; gross >= min_game; quota < 3; prospective-B width check; Position PDA absent; participant page capacity. management += load; pot += gross - load; Position pinned; PositionOpened. Replay fails: Position exists.

nodes.label: fund_series_a(gross, expected_round_id)
nodes.rationale: S/P owner. public_series_a_enabled; !paused; Active; !ticket_active; gross >= min_a; quota; entitlement fits u128; registry tail capacity. pot += gross (no load); entitlement += floor(gross*124/100); first_funding_seq on first funding; registry append if remaining > 10. Repeatable (merge).

nodes.label: withdraw_simple(position, minimum_receive, destination, max_work_contribution)
nodes.rationale: S: owner. Position open & Simple & current round; !closing; !ticket_active; now >= last_accrued_at; net >= minimum_receive; destination not GameVault/OpsCash/program PDA; if toll>0 snapshot_pages*8 >= registry_len; if closing CloseRecord(next) exists and reserve lockable (DR-12). Applies section 3.4; captures ticket; on insolvency enters Closing and pins CloseRecord.

nodes.label: settle_compounding(position, minimum_receive, destination, max_work_contribution)
nodes.rationale: As withdraw_simple but now >= expires_at and plan Compound; owed = floor(P*Q18/10^18); fee 900/1,300 bps; Position Closed; same pipeline. Replay fails: Closed.

nodes.label: close_simple_position(position)
nodes.rationale: S: owner. Simple, now >= expires_at, owed == 0 (else use withdraw). Position Closed. DR-09 says it takes max_work_contribution_lamports but section 7.2 signature omits it.

nodes.label: close_position_account(position)
nodes.rationale: S: owner; status Closed; rent returned to owner; account closed.

nodes.label: advance_ticket(rows)
nodes.rationale: Permissionless (any payer). ticket_active; phase matches; 1 <= rows <= page_capacity*k; supplied accounts re-derive to exact slots cursor..cursor+rows with matching registry_version; no duplicate writable keys. Drives Discover, Senior, SealWeights, Allocate, Prune, Commit. A completed chunk fails on cursor mismatch.

nodes.label: claim_backer(destination)
nodes.rationale: S: owner. At least one Backer present; destination not protected. For each present Backer, finalized pending credit (pending_ticket_id <= last_finalized_ticket) materializes then pays; global_funded_claims lowered; lifetime unchanged. Second call fails NothingToClaim.

nodes.label: build_candidates(rows)
nodes.rationale: Permissionless. Closing; cash_committed (or zero-toll); !sealed; rows re-derive to participant slots cursor..cursor+rows. Classifies each owner once into preferred (loss>0 and no A/B history) and/or fallback (loss>0); seals at cursor == participant_count; selected_count==0 gives Skipped(NoCandidates).

nodes.label: request_round_draw()
nodes.rationale: Permissionless. Sealed; selected_count > 0; draw_state NotRequested; Clock <= deadline; provider tuple == pinned config. Derives protocol_seed; ORAO request signed by RngAuthority funded from locked reserve; marker Requested written atomically with CPI success. Pre-existing request account is a collision error with no alternate seed.

nodes.label: capture_round_draw()
nodes.rationale: Permissionless. Requested; RequestAccount owner == ORAO program; address/client/seed/bump match; fulfilled; Clock <= deadline. Copies 64-byte randomness. Idempotent after capture; late capture is IgnoredLate no-op.

nodes.label: apply_promotion()
nodes.rationale: Permissionless. Captured; promotion Pending. Counters 0..63 mapped; winner from CandidatePage[ordinal/8][ordinal%8]; entitlement += floor(loss*116/100); has_ever_b; registry append if open; Applied or Skipped(EntropyExhausted); locked reserve settled (DR-14). Fails once terminal.

nodes.label: expire_promotion()
nodes.rationale: Permissionless. Closing; promotion Pending; Clock > deadline; draw_state != Captured. Skipped(Deadline) with diagnostic stage; locked reserve settled.

nodes.label: finalize_round()
nodes.rationale: Permissionless. Closing; cash_committed; promotion terminal; !finalized. pot += seed; seed=0; round_id += 1; participant_count=0; current_close_id=None; phase Active; finalized=true. Same close returns Ok no-op.

nodes.label: Management recipient
nodes.rationale: Signs withdraw_management to itself, bounded by accrued Front-End Load.

nodes.label: Sponsor recipient
nodes.rationale: Signs withdraw_unreserved_operations to itself, bounded by free accounted balance.

nodes.label: Initialize governance profile check
nodes.rationale: Reads Squads Multisig with correct 8-byte discriminator sha256("account:Multisig")[0..8], plain 32-byte config_authority == default, threshold 2, three voting members, time_lock 172_800 (G) / 0 (P), derives Vault PDA index 0 to compare against signer. Draft controls.rs:438 and :446 are wrong (R16).

nodes.label: Prospective-only configuration change
nodes.rationale: A staged ConfigVersion activates no earlier than effective_round_id, only in Active with no ticket.

nodes.label: 48-hour delay disclosure
nodes.rationale: The 48-hour delay holds while Squads settings and Vault ownership are intact; a quorum can shorten its own delay and can upgrade arbitrary code after the delay. Renounced upgrades and custom timelocks are deferred options, not promises.

nodes.label: Reserve checks before cash moves
nodes.rationale: Before a payout: no active ticket; snapshot pages cover captured registry_len; if closing CloseRecord(next_close_id) exists and close_reserve_lamports is lockable from ops.free_balance then owner max_work_contribution; otherwise fail before any mutation. No silent haircut, no retroactive charge.

nodes.label: Locked partitions on CloseRecord
nodes.rationale: locked_sponsor/locked_owner live on CloseRecord with immutable owner_refund_destination; not withdrawable by sponsor, G or another close.

nodes.label: Sponsor-first consumption
nodes.rationale: Provider request fee, pending-request rent, automatic B account rent and candidate-page rent consumed from sponsor partition first; owner partition covers only the quoted shortfall.

nodes.label: Reserve settlement once at terminal promotion
nodes.rationale: Unused locked_sponsor returns to ops.free_balance; unused locked_owner returns to recorded destination; provider fees already spent are consumed.

nodes.label: Rent components return at safe closure only
nodes.rationale: Shared accounts record at most two rent components (rent_funded_by_ops, rent_funded_by_owner) returned exactly once at safe closure (DR-13), never earlier.

nodes.label: Zero keeper reward
nodes.rationale: Any payer may progress; work units (3N + constants + pages) are captured for diagnostics and future pricing, not paid.

nodes.label: native_sol_bridge canister (ICP)
nodes.rationale: New canister (DR-24) owning relayer ingress, two-RPC finalized verification, outbox, cursor, PP-reward legs and the verified event store serving GUI history/feeds (DR-25). Trust boundary, not consensus. Solana note: ICP has no certified query of Solana, so it learns only from RPC reads of finalized transactions.

nodes.label: ICP event identity tuple
nodes.rationale: (cluster_domain, program_id, signature, instruction_index, inner_instruction_index, event_schema_version) plus round_id/close_id as source-round provenance separate from ICP PP round buckets.

nodes.label: Two-RPC finalized verification
nodes.rationale: Authenticated relayer proposes finalized descriptors; canister fetches the tx from two configured RPC providers via the SOL RPC canister with maxSupportedTransactionVersion at the decoder maximum, decodes the self-CPI event, requires both to agree and be finalized. Disagreement or unsupported version leaves the event pending, never skipped.

nodes.label: Reward policy freeze at first observation
nodes.rationale: At first validated observation store basis and policy snapshot and derive every leg with immutable recipient, amount, fee, 32-byte memo hash and created_at_time; status Pending -> SubmittedUnknown -> Committed | Retryable | Quarantined. Beneficiary is the signed owner or selected loser, never keeper/relayer.

nodes.label: Exactly-once PP ledger legs
nodes.rationale: Retry resubmits identical fields inside the ledger dedup window; Duplicate reconciles to prior receipt; unknown outcome past the window needs ledger-history reconciliation; unresolvable legs quarantined. No fresh timestamp remint and no write-after-await gap for the dedup record.

nodes.label: Shenanigans authorized-reward-source change
nodes.rationale: Expose the bridge as an authorized reward source for SOL plan rates (simple 6_000, compound15 12_000, compound30 18_000, backer 120_000 PP per SOL as currently configured) without changing legacy observers; solBackerSeen watermark is a legacy concern recorded in the inventory, not fixed here.

nodes.label: Events catalog (emit_cpi self-CPI events)
nodes.rationale: PositionOpened, SeriesAFunded, PayoutPaid, PositionClosed, TicketCommitted, BackerClaimed, RoundClosed, CandidatesSealed, DrawRequested, DrawCaptured, PromotionApplied, PromotionSkipped, RoundFinalized, OperationsFunded, OperationsWithdrawn, ManagementWithdrawn, ConfigStaged, ConfigActivated, AdmissionPauseSet; each carries schema_version u8. Solana note: events are observed from transaction metadata, not stored on chain.

nodes.label: External fee-only keeper worker (primary)
nodes.rationale: Routine worker holding one fee-only key with a capped balance, submitting advance_ticket, build_candidates, request_round_draw, capture_round_draw, apply_promotion, expire_promotion, finalize_round, provisioning and cleanup; no financial authority.

nodes.label: native_sol_keeper canister (ICP watchdog/backup)
nodes.rationale: Threshold-Ed25519 fee-only address, timers (idle backoff 1/5/15 min, active 30-60 s), bounded transaction journal, unknown-outcome reconciliation, re-armed timers after upgrade; signs only when progress is stale. Solana note: each signature is a management-canister call (about 26 billion cycles at the dated key_1 price) so a watchdog that signs rarely is cheap, a worker that signs thousands of times a month is not.

nodes.label: Keeper alert thresholds (60 s / 300 s)
nodes.rationale: 60 s without progress alert; 300 s escalate (replacement keeper, smaller chunk, self-funded progress, ops top-up). Operational objectives, not protocol guarantees.

nodes.label: Frontend native adapter module boundary
nodes.rationale: frontend/src/solana/native/{client,accounts,transactions,status,types}.ts plus hooks/useNativeSolana.ts; checked-in Anchor IDL with typed client; cache keys include (cluster, programId); stack unchanged (web3.js 1.98.4, wallet-adapter 0.15.39, legacy/v0 transactions); screens GamePlans, GameTracking, HouseDashboard, GameStatusBar adapted.

nodes.label: Wallet pubkey re-read and simulation before prompt
nodes.rationale: Re-read user-selected wallet pubkey at send time (native path keeps hard-fail on mismatch and adds pre-sign check); simulate before prompting; keep signature and client_nonce across unknown outcomes; never resubmit a new nonce on timeout.

nodes.label: Transaction status ladder (submitted -> confirmed -> finalized -> mirrored)
nodes.rationale: HTTPS polling only (CSP connect-src allows no wss://); null/timeout is unknown, not failure.

nodes.label: Resume processing builder
nodes.rationale: Shows ticket phase/cursor, closing deadline countdown and skipped reason; prepares the next valid chunk (default 8 rows, one-row fallback) or the composed expire/finalize/open transaction for any connected wallet; no auto-signing.

nodes.label: Labeled legacy Chain Fusion positions section
nodes.rationale: Legacy ICP-observed positions rendered in a clearly labeled secondary section with existing withdrawal/claim actions unchanged (DR-22, needs Rob).

nodes.label: Solana platform-tools toolchain pin
nodes.rationale: Build provenance records v1.48 while cached cargo-build-sbf prints v1.52; unresolved pin; plan Task 0 re-pins and re-records before any build.

nodes.label: Rent coefficient (dated scenario under SIMD-0437)
nodes.rationale: Rent mid-reduction: 6,333 live 2026-09-03; 5,080 step 2; 2,575/1,322/696 expected Nov 2026. Every rent figure is a dated scenario re-quoted at measurement and launch; program reads Rent::get().

nodes.label: Transaction format envelope (legacy/v0 1,232 B vs v1 4,096 B)
nodes.rationale: GUI stays legacy/v0 at 1,232 B (accepted). v1 4,096-byte transactions live on mainnet since Agave 4.2; keeper may adopt later only after separate measured decision; ICP bridge must decode observed v1 regardless.

nodes.label: Accepted toolchain tuple (Anchor 0.32.1 / SDK 2.3.1 / LiteSVM 0.7.1 / Agave 2.3.13)
nodes.rationale: Stay on tuple; if a Task 0 probe needs a patch, Anchor 0.32.2 is the only permitted move without a new decision. Foundation skill Kit 8/transaction v1 guidance is reference, not instruction.

nodes.label: R1: Backer split constants (frontend 35/25/40 vs executable 35/45/20)
nodes.rationale: Frontend constants BACKER_OLDEST_UPSTREAM_SHARE=0.35/OTHER=0.25/ALL=0.40 vs executable 0.35/0.45/0.20 (ponzi_math_sol/main.mo:707-709). Adopted: 35% senior / 45% proportional A / 20% equal B; frontend text is a display defect to fix in the adapter milestone.

nodes.label: R2: First Codex proposal reversed senior and proportional slices
nodes.rationale: Adopted 35/45/20; verified against main.mo:707-709 and host model goldens.

nodes.label: R3: GUI net-deposit ROI vs canister gross accrual
nodes.rationale: GUI projects ROI on net (SolInvestPanel.tsx:70-76) vs canister gross (main.mo:2808, :1077). Adopted: gross accrual; GUI projection corrected (D4).

nodes.label: R4: Legacy 5,000-lamport deduction and silent tiny payout vs wallet-paid fees
nodes.rationale: Adopted: no hidden deduction; every positive funded lamport claimable; no silent success (D5).

nodes.label: R5: Legacy quota at intent vs accepted atomic quota
nodes.rationale: Adopted: three successful open_position/fund_series_a per owner per rolling 3,600 s enforced atomically; exactly 3,600 s old has expired; failed calls and claims do not count. D5; MODELED.

nodes.label: R6: Legacy max-deposit query never enforced
nodes.rationale: Adopted: no dynamic cap in native (D5 and source behavior).

nodes.label: R7: Legacy selfServeBackingEnabled=false vs public A on
nodes.rationale: Adopted: public_series_a_enabled=true at fresh launch, disclosed as a launch-flag difference (D4).

nodes.label: R8: Legacy earnings == pot equality handling
nodes.rationale: Adopted: strict owed > pot closes; equality is solvent even when it empties the pot; a later eligible positive claim with minimum zero may close a zero pot (D7; MODELED).

nodes.label: R9: Legacy Float accrual without remainder carry
nodes.rationale: Adopted: integer numerator with carried remainder, 21-day clamp, backwards clock rejected (D5; MODELED).

nodes.label: R10: Economics doc compound-30 typo
nodes.rationale: Table said 10,672,980,269; adopted 10,672,880,269; fixture authoritative (docs/solana/economics.md).

nodes.label: R11: Close fields in Pool vs retained CloseRecord
nodes.rationale: Adopted: retained CloseRecord per close (DR-02) so old callbacks cannot attach to later rounds.

nodes.label: R12: Draft defers owner work contribution and closing/provider/reopening integration
nodes.rationale: Adopted: tranche boundaries only; full release implements them (Handoff section 6).

nodes.label: R13: createBackdatedGame hatch exists only in ponzi_math (ICP)
nodes.rationale: Handoff text names createBackdatedGame among SOL hatches; it exists only in ponzi_math. Legacy hatch list for the SOL canister is section A11 of the source map; native has no manual-credit ABI.

nodes.label: R14: Budget doc 96-byte candidate rows
nodes.rationale: Adopted: 32-byte owner rows; loss re-read from UserRound (DR-03).

nodes.label: R15: Platform-tools v1.48 vs cached v1.52
nodes.rationale: Unresolved toolchain pin; plan Task 0 re-pins and re-records before any build; no build claim made.

nodes.label: R16: Squads Multisig discriminator and config_authority parse defects in draft controls.rs
nodes.rationale: Draft controls.rs:438 discriminator ends 0xc8 vs sha256("account:Multisig") ending 0xec; :446 parses config_authority as Option<Pubkey> but Squads v4 stores plain Pubkey (default = autonomous). Fix both before any governance test is believed; the four draft unit tests are circular (inventory 5.2 #1-#2).

nodes.label: R17: Draft Pool.funded_claims u64 vs accepted u128
nodes.rationale: Adopted: u128 field asserted <= vault spendable lamports (DR-05); cost 8 bytes.

nodes.label: R18: Fixed 5,080 lamports/byte rent coefficient
nodes.rationale: Adopted: treat every rent figure as a dated scenario under SIMD-0437; re-quote at measurement and launch (DR-27).

nodes.label: R19: Assumed 1,232-byte envelope everywhere
nodes.rationale: Adopted: GUI stays legacy/v0 at 1,232 B; v1 4,096 B live on mainnet; keeper may use later after separate measured decision (DR-28); ICP bridge must decode observed v1.

nodes.label: DR-01 Reuse the uncommitted draft account seeds and names
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE. Adopt the draft seed set ([pool],[admission],[game-vault],[ops],[ops-cash],[ticket],[user,owner],[user-round,round,owner],[position,owner,nonce],[backer,series,owner],[registry,page],[snapshot,page]) as base contract and add omitted accounts (DR-02/03/04/06). Draft correctness not assumed; handlers re-derived with failing tests first. Solana note: PDA = keyless address derived from seeds + program ID, a separate rent-paying account that must be passed in every transaction touching it.

nodes.label: DR-02 Per-close retained CloseRecord instead of close fields inside Pool
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE. Keep current-round scalars in Pool; create one retained CloseRecord PDA [close, close_id] per close pinning close_started_at, promotion_deadline, sealed digests, provider request binding, terminal promotion result and finalize marker. CloseRecord for next_close_id must be provisioned (permissionless, sponsor-paid) before any payout that could close; payout writes into it only on insolvency. Rejected: init in the payout; one reused close account.

nodes.label: DR-03 Candidate and participant pages store owner pubkeys only
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE. 32-byte owner pubkey rows; loss and A/B history re-read from UserRound and User during traversal and at promotion apply. Candidate pages closable after terminal promotion; participant pages after finalization. Smallest rows, no duplicated P/L state.

nodes.label: DR-04 Versioned configuration as separate ConfigVersion PDAs
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE. ConfigVersion [config, version] holds plan rates, durations, fee bps, minima, toll split, quota, close reserve, provider tuple, effective_round_id. G stages; permissionless activate_config_version only when round_id >= effective_round_id, Active, no ticket, expected current matches. Position/CloseRecord/Ticket pin terms, enforcing no retroactive change mechanically.

nodes.label: DR-05 Width contract and serialization
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE. u64 cash partitions; u128 owed, entitlements, lifetime credited, UserRound gross/net, global funded claims; U256 (ethnum LE) sealed A denominator and products; u64 slots/cursors; Anchor 8-byte discriminators. A narrower draft field is a defect.

nodes.label: DR-06 Operations cash as a system-owned PDA paying rent by invoke_signed
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE. Keep [ops-cash] system-owned zero-data holder and program-owned [ops] ledger; shared-page creation uses manual system_program::create_account CPI signed with ops-cash seeds, not Anchor init payer (needs a client Signer). Solana note: every byte of state must be pre-funded by a signer; a PDA pays only via invoke_signed.

nodes.label: DR-07 Singleton reusable Ticket workspace
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE. One [ticket] account reused across tolls since the barrier serializes allocations; ticket_id increments and every snapshot row and pending credit carries its ticket_id so stale pages are never read as current. Rejected: per-payout Ticket PDA (rent churn).

nodes.label: DR-08 Pre-provisioned reusable SnapshotPages, permissionless sponsor-paid provisioning
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE. provision_snapshot_page permissionless from reserved operations cash; payout verifies pool.snapshot_pages*8 >= captured_active_len before accepting cash; pages overwritten only by a later ticket_id after prior ticket terminal. Interacts with DR-12.

nodes.label: DR-09 Owner work contribution in the ABI from day one, default zero
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE. withdraw_simple, settle_compounding and close_simple_position take max_work_contribution_lamports now; sponsor-first consumption and owner partition as accepted; GUI exposes advanced input default 0. Adding later would change ABI after clients exist. Note: spec section 7.2 lists close_simple_position(position) without this argument.

nodes.label: DR-10 Combined A+B claim takes both expected Backer accounts, optional by existence flag
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE. claim_backer requires User and, where has_ever_A/B set, the corresponding Backer PDA; missing required account fails; lazy materialization of finalized pending credit per present Backer; claim during an active ticket pays only previously finalized credit.

nodes.label: DR-11 Events via Anchor emit_cpi! self-CPI for every financial event
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE. Use emit_cpi! not log-based emit! for PositionOpened, SeriesAFunded, PayoutPaid, TicketCommitted, BackerClaimed, RoundClosed, PromotionApplied, PromotionSkipped, RoundFinalized; event data lives in inner-instruction data which RPC returns intact, unlike truncatable logs. Affects ICP bridge decoding.

nodes.label: DR-12 Mandatory reserve check order and amounts
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE (amounts LAUNCH). Payout checks in order: (1) no active ticket; (2) snapshot pages provisioned for captured N; (3) if closing, CloseRecord(next_close_id) exists and ops.free_balance + owner_contribution >= close_reserve_lamports then lock into locked_sponsor/locked_owner; (4) toll>0 implies ticket work. Only then cash moves. close_reserve_lamports is a ConfigVersion field from measured sizes.

nodes.label: DR-13 Beneficial rent attribution with at most two components
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE. Every sponsor-created shared account stores rent_funded_by_ops and rent_funded_by_owner; close_shared_account permissionless after safe-closure predicate (ticket terminal for snapshot pages, promotion terminal for candidate pages, round finalized for participant pages; never CloseRecord, Backer, User), returning each component exactly once. Cleanup never gates commit/finalize/reopen.

nodes.label: DR-14 Refund of unused locked reserve at terminal promotion, not at cleanup (DEVIATION: wording only)
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE (DEVIATION: wording clarification). Split two timers: locked reserve on a CloseRecord settles once when promotion becomes terminal (consumed provider fee and B rent deducted; remainder returns to ops free balance / owner destination); rent components return at safe closure under DR-13. Pools are disjoint so no lamport refunded twice; behavior and conservation unchanged.

nodes.label: DR-15 Unsolicited SOL becomes unallocated excess; no spend/sweep path
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE (accepted, no change). Plain transfers to [game-vault] raise unallocated_excess at the next instruction that reconciles physical lamports; no instruction can spend, credit or sweep it in first release; fund_operations is the only sanctioned way to give the project SOL.

nodes.label: DR-16 Participant traversal completeness proof
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE. CloseRecord.participant_count copied from Pool at close; build_candidates visits participant slots in strictly increasing order with exact cursor, re-deriving UserRound and User PDAs; sealing requires cursor == participant_count; each participant classified exactly once; sealed digest is SHA-256 over ordered candidate pubkeys per set.

nodes.label: DR-17 ORAO Callback 0.4.0, no client-level callback, direct capture
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE (accepted candidate). Register one ORAO Client owned by [rng-authority]; request_round_draw CPI-requests with the protocol seed; capture_round_draw reads the fulfilled RequestAccount directly requiring Clock <= deadline. Runtime probes executed lifecycle locally; devnet latency and mainnet quorum remain. No request-level callback.

nodes.label: DR-18 Keep expire_promotion separate from finalize_round; allow composed client transaction
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE (accepted). Composition at the transaction level (expire_promotion, finalize_round, open_position) so each instruction keeps one responsibility; open_position takes expected_round_id and fails if the round differs.

nodes.label: DR-19 Initialize against ProgramData.upgrade_authority, with two draft fixes
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE (accepted). initialize passes Program and ProgramData and requires upgrade_authority == G vault PDA and G vault signature; no first-caller enrollment. Draft fixes: Squads Multisig discriminator last byte (0xc8 should be 0xec) and config_authority parsed as Option<Pubkey> vs plain Pubkey; rebuild parser from pinned Squads source with byte-exact fixture.

nodes.label: DR-20 Guardian pause touches [admission] and the P vault signer only
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE (accepted). Tests assert the instruction account list contains no Pool, Ticket, CloseRecord, vault, Backer or provider account.

nodes.label: DR-21 Keeper hosting: external fee-only primary plus ICP watchdog
nodes.rationale: Classification: MEASURE (default = hybrid). Default stands until measurement yields full-path K (transactions/month) and CU/packet data for N~100; if measured K makes ICP signing acceptable to Rob, fully ICP becomes available; Rob decision at that point, not a gate for earlier milestones.

nodes.label: DR-26 Stay on Anchor 0.32.1 / SDK 2.3.1 / LiteSVM 0.7.1 / Agave 2.3.13
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE. Public check 2026-10-13: 0.32.1 not yanked; 0.32.2 patch on same Solana 2.x; 1.2.1 latest stable on Solana 3.x; LiteSVM 0.18.0 on Agave 4.3 while 0.7.1 remains. Accepted tuple stays; Anchor 0.32.2 is the only permitted move without a new decision.

nodes.label: DR-27 Rent figures are dated scenarios under SIMD-0437
nodes.rationale: Classification: MEASURE / LAUNCH. Rent cut in five feature-gated steps (6,960 -> 6,333 live 2026-09-03 -> 5,080 -> 2,575 -> 1,322 -> 696 lamports/byte; steps 3-5 expected with Agave 4.4, Nov 2026). Budget rebuild records active step; close_reserve_lamports and ops funding are launch inputs; no rent coefficient hard-coded, program reads Rent::get(). Solana note: rent is a refundable deposit, unlike consumed ICP cycles.

nodes.label: DR-28 Keeper transaction format
nodes.rationale: Classification: MEASURE (default = legacy/v0). v1 transactions (4,096 bytes) live on mainnet since Agave 4.2; 96-account limit not yet active. GUI keeps legacy/v0. A keeper may adopt v1 or lookup tables only after Task 11 measures the account-lock bound, without changing program economics or cursor proofs; bridge decoder must handle observed v1 regardless.

nodes.label: DR-22 Native rail is default SOL view; legacy positions in labeled secondary section
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROB. Recommendation needing Rob confirmation: within existing SOL panels show native positions/Backer/claims by default and render legacy ICP-observed positions in a labeled Legacy (Chain Fusion) section with existing actions; layout untouched. Alternative toggle rejected as hiding legacy balances. The one GUI arrangement decision changing what users see first. Needs Rob's confirmation.

nodes.label: DR-23 Transaction confirmation via HTTPS polling (confirmed for progress, finalized for authoritative state)
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE (accepted). No WebSocket; simulation before wallet prompt; signature retained across unknown outcomes; client nonce on open_position makes retries idempotent.

nodes.label: DR-24 New native_sol_bridge canister, not a modification of shenanigans observer loops
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE. One new canister owns relayer ingress, two-RPC finalized verification, outbox, cursor and PP-reward legs and calls the existing PP ledger with the exactly-once contract; shenanigans only whitelists the bridge as an authorized reward source. Keeps legacy behavior unchanged and gives the new trust boundary its own upgrade story.

nodes.label: DR-25 ICP history/feed mirror served from the bridge canister durable event store
nodes.rationale: Classification: ROUTINE. No separate indexer in first release; frontend reads live financial state from Solana and only history/feed enrichment from ICP.

nodes.label: Register G: Launch inputs (not decisions now)
nodes.rationale: Inputs supplied at launch: G/P Squads vault addresses and voters (Rob), management/sponsor recipients (Rob), program ID/cluster/cluster_domain_32 (operator), ORAO network state/treasury/client (operator), close_reserve_lamports/snapshot pages/ops funding (Rob from measured sizes), production RPC endpoints and CSP connect-src origins, bootstrap pot/seed fixed at zero.

nodes.label: Register H: Deferred optional scope
nodes.rationale: Not prerequisites: native PP/SPL and desk, proof-bearing refund of anonymous excess, paid on-chain keeper rewards, frontend v1/Kit migration, Pinocchio or custom accumulators, extra governance signers/custom timelock/renounced upgrades, ICP raw_rand provider, II/SIWS merging, legacy deposit pause/retirement.

nodes.label: Register I: Explicit non-decisions
nodes.rationale: Not reopened: strict owed > pot close; 35/45/20 with folding/sealed denominator; gross accrual; three-per-rolling-hour quota with no dynamic cap; 600 s immutable deadline with no reroll; zero keeper reward; public A on; operator eligibility; separate legacy rail; PP on ICP.

nodes.label: Native Solana Production Implementation Plan (2026-10-13)
nodes.rationale: Sixteen milestones M0-M15, stage map, test matrix and three authorization gates. Header states nothing is authorized yet and the plan is for Codex review.

nodes.label: Native Solana current-state and evidence inventory (2026-10-13)
nodes.rationale: Exact record of what exists, what was executed, what was not, and what remains unproved. Nothing in the pass built, tested, deployed, signed, funded or merged anything; hashes are SHA-256 of working-tree bytes.

nodes.label: Codex review packet for native Solana discovery, spec and plan (2026-10-13)
nodes.rationale: Prepared for Codex independent review and Rob decision. No implementation, build, test run, deployment, funding, signing, merge or canister change occurred in the pass.

nodes.label: Production accounts and financial instructions tranche (docs/solana/production-accounts.md)
nodes.rationale: Draft contract for the uncommitted production account and financial-instruction tranche at baseline c99a636. Authorized local source/SBF/LiteSVM work only; no deployment.

nodes.label: controls.rs (uncommitted production tranche draft)
nodes.rationale: 997-line draft with governance/control handlers; carries defects 1, 2 and 12 (discriminator, config_authority parse, management shortfall error naming).

nodes.label: runtime.rs (financial-runtime harness draft)

nodes.label: PDA seed list: pool, admission, game-vault, ops, ops-cash, ticket, user, user-round, position, backer, registry, snapshot
nodes.rationale: One canonical pool [pool]; admission pause [admission]; program-owned SOL custody [game-vault]; operations state [ops]; empty system-owned signer cash PDA [ops-cash]; singleton reusable allocation workspace [ticket]. User [user, owner], UserRound [user-round, round_le_u64, owner], Position [position, owner, nonce_le_u64], Backer [backer, series_u8, owner], dense global RegistryPage [registry, page_le_u64], reusable SnapshotPage [snapshot, page_le_u64]. Page capacity 8, slot/cursor/count widths u64, no economic population cap. Per-owner rent for User/UserRound/Position/A is owner paid; shared account/page storage is sponsor paid from OpsCash.

nodes.label: Cash partitions, widths and custody rules
nodes.rationale: Cash partitions u64; entitlements, lifetime credits and P/L u128; weighted denominators U256 (32-byte little-endian). GameVault spendable cash equals pot + seed + management + pending toll + funded claims + unallocated excess; rent is protected; anonymous incoming transfers increase excess, never game credit; only recorded accrued management is withdrawable by its recipient; operations contributions are separate and nonrefundable; owner destinations require the owner signature and reject protected custody aliases; runtime fees are separate.

nodes.label: Allocation design: single registry capture, 35/45/20, six phases, one-row fallback
nodes.rationale: Allocation captures the single dense registry before senior credit. Slices 35% senior / 45% proportional A / 20% equal B of the Backer half with accepted missing-tier folds. Six phases: Discover, Senior, SealWeights, Allocate, descending Prune, constant-size Commit. One-row instruction fallback is the initial measured ABI; larger batching/inline completion is an optimization to measure, not a population cap. Lifetime increases at credit; ticket-pending credit becomes claimable only at scalar watermark commit; old finalized cash remains claimable during a new ticket; claims never reduce lifetime entitlement consumption.

nodes.label: Pre-provisioned shared pages and reserve rules
nodes.rationale: Shared registry/snapshot pages are permissionlessly provisioned before financial acceptance; a payout verifies all required snapshot pages exist (Pool.snapshot_pages). Automatic closing costs additionally lock a fixed configured provider/B reserve in operations accounting before a closing payout. No on-chain keeper reward. Default owner contribution zero. Provisioning and allocation need no governance or original caller. No cash-abort/reset escape hatch.

nodes.label: Pool and Ticket contents; prune validation
nodes.rationale: Pool holds current round, financial partitions, registry length/version, next first-funding sequence, ticket IDs, snapshot page count, participant count, closing time/deadline, governance and guardian vault identities, sponsor and management recipients, configured close reserve. Ticket stores captured allocation terms/cursors/totals/oldest row, 256-bit A denominator, cash credit sums and seed delta. Prune validates original row + current last row/backer and updates moved membership before shortening the live registry; original snapshot pages stay immutable within a ticket.

nodes.label: Close barrier and pause rules
nodes.rationale: Only strict owed > pot closes; equality remains active even at zero pot. Close pins Clock+600 once and disables new financial admission and position payouts. Admission pause touches only Admission and the guardian signer. Cash claims/progress remain available while paused. Ordinary game opens remain allowed during a nonclosing allocation; A/registry mutation and further payouts are blocked until commit.

nodes.label: Governance profile G and P as Squads-v4 vault PDAs
